description: Errors and warnings for a script or several, from the editor's language server, and whether each is clean. With no editor open, a headless engine compiles instead and checkedBy says engine. Lines and columns count from 1. If staleAnalysis appears, editor_rescan first. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads.

scriptPath.description: A script, a folder (its .gd files at any depth), or a list of either, such as ["scripts/economy", "ui/shop.gd"].

name: script_diagnostics
title: Script diagnostics
